definitions.hw: 24*dayofweek + hour of the UTC timestamp, Monday 00:00 = 0
definitions.profile: count per hour of week summed over the window, divided by its mean over the 168 hours
definitions.conversations: one conversation (row) at its top-level timestamp (= its last assistant turn), as in a4
definitions.user_hours: distinct hashed IPs per region and calendar hour, summed by hour of week
definitions.r_oj: share of conversations of region o and tier j among all mapped conversations of the 5 regions
definitions.p_o_separable_utc: separable smoother: p(d, h) = (mean of day d) x (24-h profile at h), 31 parameters instead of 168, for sparse hour-of-week cells

tier_maps.default: card families, except gpt-4o-mini -> M like the other mini models
tier_maps.card: card families, gpt-4o-mini in L with the gpt-4o family
tier_maps.rule: default map: strip the version suffix from the model name; a variant in tier_map.variant_override takes that tier, every other model the tier of its card family in tier_map.family_map. Card map: the family map alone. gpt-4o-mini is never a family of its own, so the family map alone sends it to L

default.reason: (a) the whole-trace profile is unstable (split-half correlation of the weekly profile in variants.full_conversations.region_stats) and the country label stops separating regions reliably from early_end on (label_check_summary); user-hours cap each hashed IP at one per hour against heavy users; the separable smoother handles the sparse cells of the early window; r_oj comes from the same window. (b) gpt-4o-mini goes to M like gpt-4.1-mini and o1-mini
default.note: top-level p_o_hour_of_week_utc (= borrower_model.early.p_o), counts_region_hour_of_week (the user-hour counts it is built from), r_oj and counts_region_tier_hour_of_week (conversations) are those of this default; borrower_model.<name> holds p_o and r_oj of each named model together. The top-level p_o_hour_of_week_utc is the profile named by p_o_profile (the separable smoother), not the raw hour-of-week profile, which is borrower_model.<name>.p_o_hour_of_week_utc_raw (= variants.<variant>.p_o_hour_of_week_utc). rows_in_5_regions counts the whole trace; rows_in_5_regions_by_window gives each window

full.changes: sensitivity: whole trace in conversations, raw profile

early_card_map.changes: sensitivity: card tier map (gpt-4o-mini in L)

full.role: sensitivity: whole trace in conversations, raw profile

early_card_map.role: sensitivity: card tier map (gpt-4o-mini in L)

label_check_summary.reading: every month before EARLY_END separates regions (mean TV to the pooled language mix at least min_mean_tv_before); from EARLY_END on the monthly mean TV is unstable (mean_tv_from_min_max), after the volume jump, so the country label does not reliably separate regions there
